{{Top|leg}}
'''Diflu''' was the largest [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dolomar]]. It was made up of an underground cavern complex located in the northern-most mountain chain called the [[L'tiri Peaks]]. It housed multiple businesses such as [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]], shops, and repair facilities.
